bug_report: The FIFO self-test prints corrupted data instead of the six characters pushed into it.

agent.root_cause: In fifo_pop, the tail pointer check was incorrect. It should check against FIFO_SIZE (the exclusive upper bound), not FIFO_SIZE (which is out of bounds for a 0-indexed array of size 4). Changing it to >= ensures it wraps around correctly to 0 when it hits 4.

initial_evidence.uart:
boot ok
data: abcd?e
init done

evaluation.uart:
boot ok
data: abcdef
init done

args.root_cause: In fifo_pop, the tail pointer check was incorrect. It should check against FIFO_SIZE (the exclusive upper bound), not FIFO_SIZE (which is out of bounds for a 0-indexed array of size 4). Changing it to >= ensures it wraps around correctly to 0 when it hits 4.
